metrics.judge_rubric_explanation: Natural spoken phrasing with courteous receptionist tone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good day! Thank you for calling Grand Canal Dental Clinic. My name is DentaCall Receptionist. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My adult front tooth was completely knocked out 15 minutes ago playing hurling! What do I do with the tooth?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hold the tooth only by the crown and place it gently into cold milk. I am transferring you immediately to our emergency clinical team. Please stay on the line.
